other_conditions: Households identified by the Gram Panchayat are eligible
Cluster households must have a minimum of 3 to 4 cattle
Villages with a high population of cattle are given priority
Entrepreneurs, cooperatives, Gaushalas, dairies are eligible under the Commercial Model to set up large biogas/Compressed Bio‑gas plants
benefits_summary: The scheme converts cattle and organic waste into biogas and organic manure, generating income, reducing LPG expenses and improving sanitation in villages.
